title: Unit normalization of the coefficient-first compact-support projection
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ a morphism supplied with a compactification, and $W\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Write $F_f=Rf_!$, $P_f$ for the canonical coefficient-first projection [def-pur-compact-support-projection-map], and $e_W:D_f\mathbf1\otimes W\simeq W$ for unitObjectIso [def-pur-integration-transpose-data]. Then $F_f(e_W)\circ P_f(W,\mathbf1)=\lambda_{F_fW}$, the canonical derived left unitor [lem-kun-tensor-unit].

proof.text: Expand the coefficient-first projection. Use inverse-braiding naturality twice to combine its exact-pullback comparison with the unit identification. The comparison and its inverse cancel. The internal composite is the ordinary right tensor of the derived pullback unit followed by the right unitor.

proof.text: Apply the proved source-library projectionMap_rightUnitality (ProjectionFormula.Unit) to this composite. Braiding with the tensor unit identifies the resulting right unitor with the left unitor. Private swap_unit proves the equality in arbitrary braided categories; projection_unit_general and projection_unit_iso_general specialize it to the actual derived constraints.
